svg.title: Remember the backup reference point
svg.desc: Illustration labels: Monday full; Tuesday change; Wednesday change; A B C; D; E; Differential Wednesday: changes D + E since Monday full.; Incremental Wednesday: change E since the previous backup.; Restore differential: full + chosen differential.; Restore incremental: full + every required increment.. Full: All selected data. Differential: Changes since the last full backup. Incremental: Changes since the previous backup in the chain

g.text: Differential Wednesday: changes D + E since Monday full.
Incremental Wednesday: change E since the previous backup.
Restore incremental: full + every required increment.
